summary:
Iter109 — 3 Share Center follow-ups (Anomaly Flags, Digest Cadence, World-map thumbnail) validated end-to-end. Backend pytest 14/14 passing in /app/backend/tests/test_iter109_anomaly_cadence_worldmap.py (~7s). Frontend UI verified live for admin jblan2026@gmail.com on /app/agentic-ai-security → Defensibility. Weekly digest task gating verified via in-process subprocess execution of agents._run_card_engagement_weekly_digest(). Cadence left set to 'instant' at end per instructions.

Verified:
(1) Anomaly Flags — GET /api/agents/runtime/card-share/{token}/access-log rows carry `anomaly` (bool) and `anomaly_reason` (str). For a card seeded with US+Chrome/macOS baseline then AU+Firefox/Windows anomalous access, the baseline row is NOT flagged and the newer row IS flagged with 'new country · new device' (verified both in JSON and rendered in the UI badge access-anomaly-<i> — screenshot iter109_ui_anomaly_ilxEoB.png shows amber/red badge next to the AU/Bob download). Uniform-access cards correctly show no badges (spec-correct).
(2) World-map thumbnail — Expanded access-log renders SVG with data-testid=access-log-map inside wrapper access-log-map-wrap-<token>. Rows with geo_lat/geo_lon (populated best-effort by ip-api.com and cached back to card_share_access) are plotted; anomaly rows get red dots, downloads cyan, opens green. Verified UI: Access Log Test card shows dot at Ashburn, US; Anomaly Map Test card shows 6 dots including red AU marker.
(3) Digest Cadence — Governance settings dropdown data-testid=gov-card-cadence has options ['instant','weekly','off']; PUT /api/agents/runtime/governance-settings persists card_engagement_cadence and GET returns it (default 'instant'; invalid values coerced to 'instant'). Cadence gating verified via direct MongoDB peek at card_shares.alerted_open after first public open: cadence=instant → True; cadence=weekly → False; cadence=off → False. Weekly digest task (_run_card_engagement_weekly_digest) verified in subprocess: when all orgs cadence=instant no notification is created (delta=0); when set to weekly exactly one 'Weekly shared-card engagement' notification per org is created (delta=1); a second immediate call is idempotent (delta=0) via dedupe_key card-weekly:{org}:{YYYY-WW}.
(4) Regression — CSV export text/csv 200 includes 'Anomaly' column header; PDF export application/pdf 200 magic %PDF, >2 KB (branded/sealed); base access-log JSON still returns opens/downloads/access[] enriched with geo + device.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning (unchanged from iter108): <span> child of <option> — not blocking, dev-only console noise.

critical_code_review_comments: _card_access_enriched anomaly loop sorts rows chronologically ascending and correctly seeds seen_c/seen_dev from the earliest row (that row's country/device is added to seen_* AFTER the check, so it is not flagged — good). Reasons list is joined with '\u00b7' matching frontend badge text.

Country parsing uses `(r.get('geo') or '').split(',')[-1].strip()` — geo format is 'City, Country' from _geo_lookup_many so trailing segment is country. If ip-api ever returns a bare city string (single segment), a first-of-kind row would still not be flagged (empty vs empty), but a subsequent event with a resolved 'City, Country' geo would trigger a false 'new country' on that transition. Low-severity edge case worth noting; consider storing an explicit `country` field on the row instead of splitting.

Cadence gate in _card_engage_alert is checked BEFORE the alerted_{event} update — good; it means cadence toggled off/weekly leaves alerted_open at False so a later switch back to 'instant' would fire the first-open alert (intended UX per spec).
_run_card_engagement_weekly_digest re-queries organizations per-oid inside a bare try/except that swallows failures silently — same feedback as iter108: consider logger.warning inside except.

GovSettingsBody.card_engagement_cadence has no Pydantic validator; validation done manually in setter (`if in ('off','weekly','instant') else 'instant'`) — works, but a Literal[...] type would surface bad values as 422 rather than silently coercing.

WorldMapThumb.jsx polygons are stylized (6 continents) — acceptable at 300x150 thumbnail scale; dots use proper equirectangular projection. Consider prefers-reduced-motion / aria-label for accessibility (non-blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (anomaly badge, world-map SVG with dots incl. red anomaly, cadence dropdown all rendered)

seed_data_creation: Pytest mints TEST_Iter109 card-share tokens via /api/agents/runtime/card-share and generates access events via /api/agents/public/card-share/{token} with X-Forwarded-For 8.8.8.8 (Chrome/macOS UA) then 1.1.1.1 (Firefox/Windows UA); revoked on teardown. Prior seed cards (TEST_Iter109 Card gate-*, Cadence Instant/Off/Weekly Card, Anomaly Map Test, Geo Custody Test, Access Log Test) from earlier iter109 runs remain in the shared demo org and are used by the UI screenshots.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter109 (Anomaly Flags, Digest Cadence, World-map thumbnail) live and verified. Regression pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iter109_anomaly_cadence_worldmap.py (14 tests, ~7s). Key testids: access-anomaly-<i>, access-log-map, access-log-map-wrap-<token>, gov-card-cadence. Cadence values allowed: 'off'|'weekly'|'instant' (default+coerced 'instant'). Weekly digest task _run_card_engagement_weekly_digest gates on org.card_engagement_cadence=='weekly' and dedupes per ISO week (dedupe_key=card-weekly:{org}:{YYYY-WW}). Instant-alert path (_card_engage_alert) gates on cadence=='instant' and sets card_shares.alerted_{open|download}=True idempotently. Anomaly logic runs per-card over its OWN access history sorted ascending by 'at'; first row of each country/device establishes baseline (not flagged). geo_lat/geo_lon are cached back onto card_share_access rows so subsequent access-log GETs and CSV/PDF exports are stable without re-hitting ip-api.com. If reusing motor across asyncio.run() invocations in one process, use subprocess-per-invocation (Event loop is closed error otherwise) — see the /app/backend anonymous subprocess script used to validate weekly gating in this iteration.
